subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Recent Booking
body: Dear Customer, This is a friendly reminder that the payment for your recent hotel booking is due by the end of this week. Please log in to your account to settle the outstanding amount to avoid any inconvenience during your stay. Thank you for choosing our services, and we look forward to welcoming you soon. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Best regards, The Booking Team
